facts.text: I am trying to organize my digital life.
I want help setting up a folder system on my laptop to store photos and contacts.
I want to store photos and contacts from people I have met recently.
I want to create a subfolder for contacts under "Individuals".
I am waiting for some photos from a freelance photographer I met on a flight to LA a few weeks ago named Jack.
I want help creating a simple spreadsheet to keep track of books I want to read.
I want the spreadsheet to include columns for the book title, author, and a priority level.
I got book recommendations from Margaret, a retired librarian I met at the grocery store.
I want to add a column for the date I want to finish reading each book.
I am thinking of organizing my writing group meetings with Alex.
Alex is a writer I met at a book reading.
I need to check my calendar to schedule the meeting with Alex.
